description: Year-by-year citation counts for a topic. Returns annual citation totals for publications matching the query over the specified year range.

endYear.description: Last year of the time range (inclusive)

query.description: Search query to identify publications (e.g., 'CRISPR gene editing')

searchIn.description: Search index for `query`. Omit to search full text (full_data). Use title_abstract_only when ranking or counting work that is about a topic — full text also matches records that only mention the terms in passing. Other common values: title_only, full_data_exact (full text without stemming). Valid indexes differ by entity; see searchIndexes in dimensions://fields/{entityType}. Requires `query`.

startYear.description: First year of the time range (inclusive)

name: citation_trend
title: Citation trend
